events.title: My Fairy Princess– Joins Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Let's witness our daughter's growth together!Thank you for your continued support and interest in our game! My Fairy Princess is confirmed to be part of Steam Next Fest. Come and try the demo!Game IntroductionIn My Fairy Princess, you raise a daughter in a vibrant world of multiple endings. Plan her life and journey beside her through a fabled realm of humans, yaoguai, and immortals.
